## Où j'en suis

Sam wants the AE owner and ARR from HubSpot shown on the admin accounts page. The webhook approach was dropped because private app tokens can't manage webhook subscriptions. It was replaced by a sync job that polls the CRM search every 15 minutes, pages in windows past the 10k result cap, and only takes companies with ARR > 0. The work is in commits 8b3e6f1, 2d90ac4 and ae47c15. PR #409 is still open, not merged. An earlier message said it was merged, but the e2e check `test_accounts_table_shows_owner` failed, so auto-merge is waiting.

- [en-cours] Fixing the e2e test `test_admin_accounts.py` so the failing check on #409 passes.
- [prochaine-étape] Fix the e2e fixture, then let #409 merge. Noa adds `HUBSPOT_TOKEN` to Secrets Manager for staging and prod.
- [essai-raté] Registering webhook subscriptions with the private app token returned 401: this API needs a developer API key from a public app. Also, CRM search never returns more than 10,000 results per query, which the windowed paging now works around.
- [question] Fix the fixture by giving the third company ARR > 0, or by expecting 2 rows?
- [décision] Close PR #405 and replace webhooks with polling every 15 minutes (source: t04)
- [décision] Sync only companies with ARR > 0 and skip trials (source: t10)
- [décision] The token goes in Secrets Manager for staging and prod, and Noa adds it (source: t12)
